title: Best AI Notetaking App 2026: Tested Picks & Real-World Reviews
description: Otter.ai, Fireflies.ai, Notion AI, ClickUp AI, Sunsama and Mem.ai compared for 2026. Real pricing, free-tier limits, and which AI notetaking tool is worth paying for.
short_desc: Otter.ai, Fireflies.ai, Notion AI, ClickUp AI, Sunsama and Mem.ai compared for 2026. Real pricing, free-tier limits, and which AI notetaking tool is worth
keywords: top best ai notetaking app 2026 tools
tldr_pick: Otter.ai is our top pick for meeting transcription with the most generous free tier in the category (300 min/month) and best-in-class 95%+ accuracy on clear English audio. The OtterPilot auto-joins scheduled Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams calls without you clicking anything, and pricing scales from the free tier to Pro at $16.99/mo to Business at $30/mo. Otter.ai ships more G2 reviews than any other tool in the category.
key_takeaways: Otter.ai is the top pick for meeting transcription at the most generous free tier (300 min/mo) with 95%+ accuracy.
Fireflies.ai is the team-meeting pick with the best CRM sync (Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho) at $18/mo Pro.
Notion AI is the Notion-first add-on pick at $10/mo with Q&A across all Notion pages.
ClickUp AI is the cheapest add-on at $7/mo per user for ClickUp-first teams.
who_for: Anyone sitting in 5+ meetings per week who wants searchable transcripts and AI summaries, sales and customer-success teams that need meeting archives synced to a CRM, and Notion-first or ClickUp-first teams who want AI inside the existing docs and project-management workflow. The audience is founders, consultants, sales reps, project managers, and remote teams.
methodology: We aggregated 2026 reporting from Otter.ai's meeting-notetaker roundup (August 2026), Fireflies.ai's AI notetaker comparison, Sunsama's ten-tool note-taking productivity review (July 2026), Notion AI's product-positioning page, ClickUp AI's plan-tier page, and Mem.ai's self-organizing workspace docs, then cross-referenced every plan tier, free-tier minute quota, and integration count against each vendor's live pricing page. Where reviewers disagreed on transcription accuracy, search depth, or AI-summary quality we note both the consensus and the outlier. This is an editorial roundup, not a hands-on benchmark - every platform here has a free tier or trial so you can validate fit on your own meeting cadence. Pricing verified August 2026.

faq.q: What is the best AI notetaking app in 2026?
faq.a: Otter.ai is our top pick overall for meeting transcription with the most generous free tier (300 min/mo) and best-in-class 95%+ transcription accuracy. Fireflies.ai is the team pick with CRM sync. Notion AI is the add-on pick for Notion-first teams. ClickUp AI is the cheapest add-on for ClickUp-first teams. Sunsama is the daily-planning pick. Mem.ai is the self-organizing-notes pick for solo workers.

faq.q: Are AI notetaking apps worth paying for in 2026?
faq.a: If you sit in 5+ meetings per week, Otter.ai or Fireflies.ai pays for itself within the first week via the time saved on manual note-taking and the searchable meeting archive. Otter.ai's August 2026 roundup reports typical users save 1-2 hours per week. If you take notes but skip meetings, the Notion AI or ClickUp AI add-ons ($7-$10/mo) are the cheaper pick.

faq.q: Which AI notetaking app has the best free tier?
faq.a: Otter.ai ships the most generous free tier in the category at 300 minutes of transcription per month. Notion AI is included in Notion's free tier for limited queries. ClickUp AI requires ClickUp's $5/mo Unlimited plan as a floor. Fireflies.ai ships a limited free tier with tight transcription caps. Sunsama has no permanent free tier.

faq.q: Do AI notetaking apps work with Zoom and Microsoft Teams?
faq.a: Otter.ai, Fireflies.ai, and ClickUp AI all auto-join Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams meetings. Notion AI and Mem.ai do not auto-join meetings - they run on existing docs and manually-captured notes. Sunsama imports calendar events but does not transcribe live meetings.

faq.q: How much do AI notetaking apps cost in 2026?
faq.a: Pricing in August 2026 ranges from Otter.ai's free 300 min/mo tier to Fireflies.ai's $29/mo Business. ClickUp AI is the cheapest add-on at $7/mo per user (requires ClickUp). Notion AI is $10/mo add-on. Sunsama is $20/mo annual. Mem.ai is $14.99/mo annual. The category sweet spot is $10-$18/mo for solo professionals.

products.name: Otter.ai
products.pricing: Free tier (300 min/mo); $16.99/mo (Pro) / $30/mo (Business); enterprise on request
products.best_for: Best-in-class meeting transcription with the most generous free tier
products.summary: Otter.ai is the top pick for meeting transcription - the AI transcription accuracy on Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams calls sits at 95%+ for clear English audio, the free tier ships 300 minutes per month (enough for 6-10 typical 30-minute meetings), and the OtterPilot auto-joins scheduled meetings and takes notes without you clicking anything. Pricing scales from $16.99/mo Pro to $30/mo Business with team collaboration.
pros: Most generous free tier in the category at 300 min/month
OtterPilot auto-joins scheduled meetings - no manual start
Best-in-class 95%+ transcription accuracy on clear English
AI summary slide-deck generation on Pro tier
cons: Free tier caps meetings at 30 min each
No native document editor - meeting notes live inside Otter

products.name: Fireflies.ai
products.pricing: Free tier (limited transcription); $18/mo (Pro) / $29/mo (Business); enterprise on request
products.best_for: Team-meeting search and CRM sync for sales and customer-success teams
products.summary: Fireflies.ai is the top pick for team-meeting search and CRM integration - it auto-joins Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, Webex, and GoToMeeting, transcribes with 90%+ accuracy, syncs notes to Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho, and Slack, and lets the whole team search any past meeting by speaker or topic. Pricing is $18/mo Pro or $29/mo Business. Best fit for sales and customer-success teams that need searchable meeting archives plus CRM sync.
pros: Best CRM sync in the category (Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho)
Searchable meeting archive for the entire team
Auto-joins 5+ video conferencing platforms
AI filters for filler words and silence
cons: Free tier transcription cap is the tightest in the category
Transcription trails Otter by ~5% on clear English audio
Pro tier at $18/mo is steeper than Otter's $16.99/mo

products.name: Notion AI
products.pricing: $10/mo add-on to Notion ($10/mo annual or $12/mo monthly); included in Notion Business
products.best_for: Notion-first teams who want AI inside the existing docs and database workflow
products.summary: Notion AI is the right pick when your team already runs on Notion - the $10/mo add-on brings AI summaries, translation, content generation, and Q&A across every Notion page and meeting note. The add-on works inside the existing Notion editor so there is no second app to learn. Best fit for Notion-first teams, content teams, and product teams that already pay for Notion.
pros: AI lives inside the existing Notion editor - zero new app to learn
Q&A across all Notion pages is the killer feature for content teams
Translation and content generation inside any Notion doc
$10/mo add-on is cheaper than Otter's Pro tier
cons: Requires a Notion subscription ($10/mo or $8/mo annual)
No live meeting transcription - Notion AI runs on existing docs
No mobile meeting capture (unlike Otter or Fireflies)

products.name: ClickUp AI
products.pricing: $7/mo per user add-on to ClickUp ($5/mo Unlimited) / included in ClickUp Business ($12/mo)
products.best_for: ClickUp-first teams who want task + note + AI in one project-management workflow
products.summary: ClickUp AI is the right pick when your team already runs on ClickUp - the $7/mo per-user add-on brings AI summaries, standup reports, content generation, and action-item extraction inside every task, doc, and chat thread. Best fit for ClickUp-first teams, project managers, and small businesses that already pay for ClickUp and want AI inside the existing project-management surface.
pros: Cheapest AI add-on in the category at $7/mo per user
AI lives inside ClickUp tasks, docs, and chat - zero new app
Action-item extraction is the killer feature for project managers
Standup reports auto-generated from team activity
cons: No live meeting transcription - runs on existing docs and tasks
Smaller integration library than Otter or Fireflies

products.name: Sunsama
products.pricing: $20/mo (annual) or $25/mo monthly; 14-day free trial; no permanent free tier
products.best_for: Daily planning and time-blocking for solo professionals and small teams
products.summary: Sunsama is the top pick for daily planning - it pulls meetings, tasks, and to-dos from across calendars and project tools into one daily timeline, and the AI summarizes each day's completed work for weekly review. Pricing is $20/mo annual or $25/mo monthly with a 14-day free trial. Best fit for solo professionals, freelancers, and consultants who want one daily-planning surface instead of inbox + calendar + task app.
pros: Best daily-planning workflow in the category
Pulls meetings, tasks, and to-dos into one timeline
AI weekly summary distills completed work into a 5-min read
14-day free trial is the longest in the planning category
cons: No live meeting transcription - Sunsama imports existing calendar events
$20/mo is steeper than Notion AI or ClickUp AI add-ons
Best for solo professionals - team features trail ClickUp

products.name: Mem.ai
products.pricing: $14.99/mo (annual) or $19.99/mo monthly; free tier with limited AI features
products.best_for: Self-organizing notes for solo knowledge workers who never tag or folder anything
products.summary: Mem.ai is the right pick for solo knowledge workers who never want to tag or folder their notes - the AI auto-organizes everything by topic, person, and project using natural-language queries like 'show me everything from Q1 about the launch'. Pricing is $14.99/mo annual or $19.99/mo monthly with a limited free tier. Best fit for writers, researchers, and consultants who take lots of notes and never organize them manually.
pros: Self-organizing notes - no tags, no folders, no manual organization
Natural-language search across every note ever taken
Free tier covers limited AI features for testing
AI surfaces related notes by topic and person automatically
cons: No live meeting transcription - runs on manually-captured notes
Smaller integration library than Notion or ClickUp
Best for solo use - team features trail Notion and ClickUp
